headline: Broad-based pharma growth, led by strong brands and differentiated product launches

highlights: EBITDA grew 9.8% to Rs17.6bn, but margins declined by 393bps to 22.2% as Saroglitazar launch, R&D, and acquisition costs increased; adjusted PAT fell 15.7% to Rs8.3bn and reported PAT declined 26.5% to Rs9.3bn, impacted by lower other income and doubled depreciation and amortisation.

Outlook: We expect Zydus Lifesciences to deliver 12.2% revenue CAGR over FY27- 29E to Rs411.6bn, driven by market-share gains in India chronic therapies (cardiology, diabetology, and oncology), growth in consumer wellness (Sugar Free, Complan, and Nycil), and US expansion through high-barrier specialty products, complex injectables, first-to-market launches, and specialty assets.
Saroglitazar (MASH/PBC), Sentynl's rare disease portfolio, and expansion across Latin America and emerging markets provide additional growth levers.

We have also raised our valuation multiple from 21x to 26x Sep-28E EPS in line with peer average (Sun, Cipla, DRL, Zydus, and Lupin) and +1SD above 10-year average, reflecting improving growth prospects, a stronger earnings trajectory, and the increasing contribution of differentiated businesses across specialty and biologics.
valuation: Valuation: We upgrade Zydus Lifesciences to BUY from Hold, with a revised target price of Rs1,458/share (earlier Rs1,274), rolling forward our valuation to Sep-28E.

We have also raised our valuation multiple from 21x to 26x Sep-28E EPS in line with peer average (Sun, Cipla, DRL, Zydus, and Lupin) and +1SD above 10-year average, reflecting improving growth prospects, a stronger earnings trajectory, and the increasing contribution of differentiated businesses across specialty and biologics.
We believe the higher multiple is justified by the company's diversified growth drivers and potential for sustained earnings compounding.

Key monitorables remain employee and SG&A cost moderation and successful commercialisation of the NCE and biosimilar pipeline.
